words.sentence: She worked hard and finally achieved her goal of running a marathon.
words.sentence_zh: 她努力工作，最终实现了跑完马拉松的目标。

words.sentence: Lack of sleep can affect your mood and your memory.
words.sentence_zh: 睡眠不足会影响你的心情和记忆力。

words.sentence: The teacher used a new approach to explain difficult math problems.
words.sentence_zh: 老师用一种新方法来讲解难懂的数学题。

words.sentence: The climate in this city is mild and rainy in spring.
words.sentence_zh: 这座城市的气候在春天温和多雨。

words.sentence: Many volunteers contribute their time to help the local community.
words.sentence_zh: 很多志愿者贡献时间，帮助当地社区。

words.sentence: Good communication is critical to the success of any team.
words.sentence_zh: 良好的沟通对任何团队的成功都至关重要。

words.sentence: This medicine is effective for treating most common colds.
words.sentence_zh: 这种药对治疗大多数普通感冒有效。

words.sentence: The new project will involve people from several different departments.
words.sentence_zh: 这个新项目将涉及几个不同部门的人。

words.sentence: Parents should not neglect their children's emotional needs.
words.sentence_zh: 父母不应该忽视孩子的情感需求。

words.sentence: Our textbook explains the political system of several countries in detail.
words.sentence_zh: 我们的教材详细介绍了几个国家的政治制度。

words.sentence: Young players with great potential often train hard every day.
words.sentence_zh: 有很大潜力的年轻球员通常每天都刻苦训练。

words.sentence: Scientists can predict the weather more accurately than before.
words.sentence_zh: 科学家现在能比以前更准确地预测天气。

words.sentence: The store will promote its new products with a big sale.
words.sentence_zh: 商店将通过大型促销活动推广新产品。

words.sentence: Stress can have a serious psychological effect on people.
words.sentence_zh: 压力会对人产生严重的心理影响。

words.sentence: The psychologist helped him understand why he felt anxious.
words.sentence_zh: 心理学家帮他理解了自己为什么感到焦虑。

words.sentence: The school decided to raise money for a new library.
words.sentence_zh: 学校决定筹集资金建一座新图书馆。

words.sentence: I recommend this book to anyone who loves history.
words.sentence_zh: 我把这本书推荐给每一个喜欢历史的人。

words.sentence: The government has introduced new regulations for food safety.
words.sentence_zh: 政府为食品安全出台了新的法规。

words.sentence: Many people relate to the main character's struggle in the story.
words.sentence_zh: 很多人能与故事主人公的挣扎产生共鸣。

words.sentence: My relative lives in Canada, and I visit her every year.
words.sentence_zh: 我的一位亲戚住在加拿大，我每年都去看她。

words.sentence: This painting represents the beauty of nature in autumn.
words.sentence_zh: 这幅画展现了秋天自然的美。

words.sentence: Every employee has the responsibility to protect company data.
words.sentence_zh: 每位员工都有责任保护公司的数据。

words.sentence: Many students struggle with managing their time during exams.
words.sentence_zh: 很多学生在考试期间难以管理好时间。

words.sentence: The change in her voice was subtle, but I still noticed it.
words.sentence_zh: 她声音里的变化很细微，但我还是注意到了。

words.sentence: Trade between the two countries has grown quickly in recent years.
words.sentence_zh: 近年来两国之间的贸易增长很快。

words.sentence: Setting unrealistic goals can make you feel like a failure.
words.sentence_zh: 设定不切实际的目标会让你觉得自己失败了。

words.sentence: The museum displays various objects from ancient China.
words.sentence_zh: 博物馆展出了来自古代中国的各种文物。

words.sentence: The bright colors of the flowers attract many bees.
words.sentence_zh: 花朵鲜艳的颜色吸引了许多蜜蜂。
